description: Strips tracking junk off any link you copy — system-wide, not just in the browser. Same real URL, trimmed.
notes: nudl runs in the system tray (nudlw.exe, the 'nudl' Start menu shortcut). On first launch it asks whether to clean links on a hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+V) or automatically as you copy them, and whether to start with Windows.
`nudl` is the command line: Get-Clipboard | nudl | Set-Clipboard
Settings, the rule set and the local audit log live in %AppData%\nudl\.
nudl makes no network calls. Your links never leave your machine.
